designationHistory.indexText: Established in 1965 after the Migratory Bird Conservation Commission approved the refuge on May 18, 1965, as wintering habitat for the dusky Canada goose.

authority.citation: Migratory Bird Conservation Act; Migratory Bird Conservation Commission approval, May 18, 1965

designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year. The refuge page does not say how it was established.

sources.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service: Ridgefield National Wildlife Refuge, About Us
FWS news release, May 1965: Migratory Bird Conservation Commission approved the new 6,131-acre Ridgefield NWR on May 18, 1965, as wintering habitat for dusky Canada geese

review.note: Year confirmed; MBCC approval date added.

designationHistory.indexOriginal: Ridgefield NWR was established in 1965 to provide wintering habitat for the dusky subspecies of the Canada goose whose habitat is extremely limited.
